# Solco

> Solco is a DJ library app in private alpha. It grids, keys, sorts and tags every track you add, on your own computer, then writes the rekordbox-format USB drive Pioneer CDJ and XDJ players read, with no rekordbox needed. It runs on macOS on Apple Silicon, Windows and Linux.

Solco imports playlists, cues, loops, ratings and colours from rekordbox, Traktor and Apple Music. Exports only add and update; replacing or erasing a drive are separate actions that show what goes first. The alpha is free, and DJs are invited in small groups from the waitlist at getsolco.com.

## Site

- [Solco](https://getsolco.com/): What Solco does, the questions DJs ask first, and the waitlist.
- [App privacy](https://getsolco.com/app-privacy/): The privacy notice for the Solco app, api.getsolco.com and the help center, in German and English.

## Help center

Guides to every step, at https://support.getsolco.com. The articles are in English.

- [Getting started with Solco](https://support.getsolco.com/hc/solco/articles/solco-getting-started): Add your music, let Solco prepare every track, build playlists and put them on a USB drive your CDJs and XDJs read.
- [Installing Solco on macOS, Windows and Linux](https://support.getsolco.com/hc/solco/articles/solco-installing-solco): Which computers Solco runs on, which download to choose, and how to install it on a Mac, a Windows PC or Linux.
- [The private alpha and its expiry date](https://support.getsolco.com/hc/solco/articles/solco-the-private-alpha): What the private alpha is, why each build runs for 30 days, and what still works after a build expires.
- [Contacting the Solco team](https://support.getsolco.com/hc/solco/articles/solco-contacting-the-solco-team): Send a message from inside Solco, attach a diagnostic summary you can read first, and get replies in the app.
- [Supported players, computers and apps](https://support.getsolco.com/hc/solco/articles/solco-supported-players-computers-and-apps): The players, computers, operating systems and DJ apps Solco works with, what has been tested, and the known limitations.
- [Importing from rekordbox, Traktor and Apple Music](https://support.getsolco.com/hc/solco/articles/solco-importing-from-other-apps): Bring your playlists, cues, loops, ratings and colours into Solco without changing your files or the other app's library.
- [Exporting to a CDJ or XDJ USB drive](https://support.getsolco.com/hc/solco/articles/solco-exporting-to-a-cdj-usb): Put your playlists on a USB drive Pioneer players read, set what the players show, continue a rekordbox drive, and eject safely.
- [Exporting playlists for Traktor and other apps](https://support.getsolco.com/hc/solco/articles/solco-traktor-and-m3u8-export): Write your playlists as a Traktor collection with cues, loops and grids, or as M3U8 files for Serato, Engine DJ, rekordbox and others.
- [Updating Solco](https://support.getsolco.com/hc/solco/articles/solco-updating-solco): How Solco finds and installs new alphas, what it sends to check, and how to update by hand.
- [Privacy, error reports and diagnostics](https://support.getsolco.com/hc/solco/articles/solco-privacy-and-diagnostics): What Solco sends, to whom and when, what stays on your computer, and which of it you can turn off.
- [Troubleshooting USB drives and exports](https://support.getsolco.com/hc/solco/articles/solco-troubleshooting-usb-exports): What to do when Solco doesn't see a USB drive, rekordbox has it open, an export stops, or you want to check a drive before a gig.
- [Backing up and restoring your Solco library](https://support.getsolco.com/hc/solco/articles/solco-backing-up-your-library): Save a backup of your playlists and preparation, what Solco backs up by itself, and how to go back to a backup.

## Optional

- [Impressum](https://getsolco.com/impressum.html): The legal notice for getsolco.com, in German and English.
